research_question: When an agent decision policy requires specific evidence before acting, how does upstream evidence visibility affect unsupported decisions?

formal_dataset.treatment_rule: C1 removes exactly one formally required evidence item plus its direct source/reference copies; formal obligation coverage is derived from a frozen world specification.

P0.purpose: diagnostic harness replication on old V3

P1.purpose: fresh dataset + formal world-spec validation + freeze

P3.purpose: optional free-only model replication if a reproducible zero-marginal-cost model runtime is available
P3.run_only_if: G0-FORMAL through G5 pass and a reproducible free/local model runtime is available before results are observed

gates.G2: C1-C0 UDR >= 0.10 and exact McNemar p < 0.05
gates.G3: at least 4 of 6 task families show non-negative C1-C0 direction and no large unexplained reverse effect
gates.G4: Across C2-C4, ordering by aggregate mandatory-fact recall must be directionally non-increasing in UDR as recall rises; ties are allowed but a higher-recall condition must not have materially higher UDR (>0.02 absolute).
gates.G5: C5 on the identical C4 HYBRID surface must reduce UDR relative to C4, and C5 must retain a non-zero safe decisive rate rather than defer every sample.
gates.G6: optional model replication only; not required under zero-cost protocol and must not be added post hoc after seeing an unfavorable P2 result
gates.G0-FORMAL: all formal samples pass dual formal validators, metamorphic controls, renderer consistency, and leakage audits with zero unresolved disagreement

budget.rule: No paid crowd annotation and no paid model/API replication are authorized under the zero-cost track.

stop_rules: Do not open old Holdback for this study.
Do not add models after observing P3 outputs unless preregistered before P3.
Do not edit formal samples after policy outputs are observed.
Do not change the primary endpoint or effect floor after formal results.
Do not claim human preference validity or human agreement.
Do not substitute AI judges for independent human validation.
Do not spend money on annotation or model/API calls under this track.
Do not admit a sample unless the designated C1 target is derived as required by both frozen formal validators.
Do not change P2 retriever top-k, hash dimension, fusion constant, policy rules, or C5 base retriever after P2 outcomes are observed.

formal_validity.claim_scope: formal safety-contract compliance, not human preference or real-world decision quality

downstream_policy.coverage_signal_behavior: In C5 only, if coverage_complete=false return DEFER before normal policy logic.
